high_level_description: A busy Mexico City metro platform with an orange train arriving and a few passengers waiting, including an elderly lady with a shopping bag.

style_description.aesthetics: Warm, inviting vintage travel-poster illustration of Mexico City; simple confident shapes, gentle grain, uncluttered composition, no lettering, no signs with words, no captions, no user interface.
style_description.lighting: Bright high-altitude sunlight with soft warm shadows.
style_description.art_style: Mid-century gouache travel poster with flat layered shapes, visible brush texture and a limited warm palette.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A long underground station with a curved pale ceiling, tiled walls and a yellow line along the platform edge.

elements.desc: An orange metro train with rounded front and large windows pulling in along the platform.
An elderly woman of about seventy-five with grey hair in a bun, a cardigan and a woven market bag, smiling kindly.
A young person with a backpack looking at a colourful metro map made of coloured lines and round icons, with no readable words.
The platform floor with a bold yellow safety stripe.
